title: Hurricane Katrina forced New Orleans’ Charity Hospital to close in 2005; now it is being transformed into a $500 million medical research hub
summary_full: The historic Charity Hospital in New Orleans is set to undergo a remarkable transformation into a cutting-edge medical research facility. Spearheaded by Tulane University, this ambitious $500 million project aims to establish a vibrant biomedical innovation hub, with construction kicking off this fall and projected completion by 2029. This redevelopment not only honors the landmark's legacy but also demonstrates a robust commitment to improving healthcare for the Gulf South community.
